subject: boxplot: horizontal bar at median? vertical bars dashed instead of solid?

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: boxplot: horizontal bar at median? vertical bars dashed instead of solid?
parts:
Hi,

I have two questions concerning the boxplot given below:

1) How can I plot a (broad) horizontal bar at the position of the
median? I tried to adapt what Kohske posted on
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/8134699/can-i-get-boxplot-notches-in-ggplot2
but I didn't know how to give the "crossbar" a "height". Then I tried
to use a rectangle (see below)...

2) How can I make the vertical bars (extending to the "whiskers")
dashed instead of solid?

Thanks & Cheers,

Marius

require(ggplot2)
require(reshape2)
require(plyr)

set.seed(1)

## parameters
p1 <- c(5, 20, 100)
p2 <- c("f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5")
p3 <- c("g1","g2","g3","g4","g5")
N <- 1000

## lengths
l1 <- length(p1)
l2 <- length(p2)
l3 <- length(p3)

## build result array containing the measurements
arr <- array(rep(NA, l1*l2*l3*N), dim=c(l1, l2, l3, N),
dimnames=list(
p1=p1,
p2=p2,
p3=p3,
N=1:N))
for(i in 1:l1){
for(j in 1:l2){
for(k in 1:l3){
arr[i,j,k,] <- i+j+k+runif(N, min=-4, max=4)
}
}
}
arr <- arr + rexp(3*5*5*N)

## create molten data
mdf <- melt(arr, formula = . ~ p1 + p2 + p3 + N) # create molten data
frame

## confidence interval calculated by `boxplot.stats`
f <- function(x){
ans <- boxplot.stats(x)
data.frame(x=x, y=ans$stats[3], ymin=ans$conf[1], ymax=ans
$conf[2])
}

## (my poor) trial
ggplot(mdf, aes(x=p3, y=value)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=1) +
stat_summary(fun.data=f, geom="rectangle", colour=NA, fill="black",
xmin=x-0.36, xmax=x+0.36, ymin=max(y-0.2, ymin), ymax=min(y+0.2,
ymax)) +
facet_grid(p2 ~ p1, scales = "free_y")
